evidence.supports: Board unanimously extended the moratorium to 2026-10-17 on 2026-06-03.
evidence.quote: Motion to approve the Resolution extending the temporary moratorium on applications for Zoning and Building review with respect to data centers and digital mining uses until October 17, 2026.

evidence.supports: A further extension resolution was on the 2026-09-16 Board agenda.

decisions.notes: savrn is wrong: it treated the original term (reported variously as to 2026-06-17 or 2026-07-01) as the end and missed the 2026-06-03 extension to 2026-10-17. Separate from this contradiction: the row's coordinates (44.814831, -83.617911) point to Caledonia Township in Alcona County, but this is Caledonia Charter Township in Kent County (about 42.79, -85.52). Flagged for the geocode pass, not changed here.

evidence.supports: Board adopted Resolution No. 2026-17 extending the moratorium on 2026-08-12 by unanimous roll call.
evidence.quote: Motion by Osman, supported by Marcy, to adopt Resolution No. 2026-17, a resolution to extend the existing moratorium on the acceptance of building and zoning applications for data center development, pending the approval of the new ordinance.

decisions.notes: savrn and aigridwatch are wrong: they stopped at the six-month term (about 2026-08-11) and missed Resolution No. 2026-17 (2026-08-12), which extended it about three months pending the new data center ordinance. The row already records this.
